verification.notes: The reported donor was Robert Shillman, not 'Shulman.' The Grayzone says he cancelled a planned honorary plaque and announced an end to donations on September 6, four days before Kirk's death; it does not support the specific 48-hour timing or a demand to remove an existing building name. The account relies on anonymous/private-event sources and was not confirmed by Shillman or TPUSA.

verification.notes: Leaked messages attributed to Charlie Kirk and subsequently confirmed as authentic by TPUSA report losing a $2 million-per-year donor because TPUSA would not cancel Tucker Carlson. Grayzone reporting and New York Times-derived coverage identify that donor as Cognex founder Robert J. Shillman. The official Cognex record confirms the spelling; “Bob Schulman/Shulman” was a transcript/name error. The incident is supported by multiple reports, though no public donor withdrawal letter was found.
